CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE wide_ranges AS (
	SELECT 
		id,
		'2026-01-01'::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL (id * 5 * 2048 // 7) SECONDS AS start,
		'2026-01-01'::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL ((id + 1) * 5 * 2048 // 7) SECONDS AS stop,
		CHR(65 + (id % 26)::INTEGER) AS symbol,
		149.5 + id * 5 * 2048 / 700.0 AS price,
	FROM range(6) tbl(id)
);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE narrow_ranges AS (
	SELECT 
		id,
		'2026-01-01'::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL (id) SECONDS AS start,
		start + INTERVAL 1 SECOND AS stop,
		CHR(65 + (id % 26)::INTEGER) AS symbol,
		150.0 + id / 100.0 AS bid,
		(id % 2)::BOOLEAN AS active,
	FROM range(2048*5) tbl(id)
);

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(orders_by_customer.c1, 1e308) = 0 OR COALESCE(orders_by_customer.c2, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
FROM csp_pm_a
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
	       COUNT(product_info.name1) AS c1,
	       COUNT(product_info.name2) AS c2
	FROM csp_pm_o
	INNER JOIN csp_pm_i ON csp_pm_o.id = csp_pm_i.order_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT csp_pm_p.id,
		       category_info.name1 AS name1,
		       category_info.name2 AS name2
		FROM csp_pm_p
		LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT csp_pm_c.name,
			       csp_pm_c.short_name AS name1,
			       csp_pm_c.short_name AS name2
			FROM csp_pm_c
			WHERE csp_pm_c.demand <= 2::SMALLINT
		) AS category_info
		ON csp_pm_p.category = category_info.name
		WHERE csp_pm_p.alert_at >= ('18:30:00.178')::TIMETZ
	) AS product_info
	ON csp_pm_i.product_id = product_info.id
	GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
) AS orders_by_customer
ON csp_pm_a.customer_id = orders_by_customer.customer_id
LEFT JOIN csp_pm_tx
ON csp_pm_a.id = csp_pm_tx.a_id
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
	       MAX(repeated_order.v) AS v
	FROM csp_pm_o
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
		       MIN(DISTINCT csp_pm_o.customer_id) AS v
		FROM csp_pm_o
		GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
	) AS repeated_order
	ON csp_pm_o.customer_id = repeated_order.customer_id
	WHERE csp_pm_o.flag != FALSE
	GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
) AS unreferenced_branch
ON csp_pm_a.customer_id = unreferenced_branch.customer_id;

	 ANTI JOIN csp_pm_c_deletes d ON tbl.name = d.name);
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(orders_by_customer.c1, 1e308) = 0 OR COALESCE(orders_by_customer.c2, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
FROM csp_pm_a
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
	       COUNT(product_info.name1) AS c1,
	       COUNT(product_info.name2) AS c2
	FROM csp_pm_o
	INNER JOIN csp_pm_i ON csp_pm_o.id = csp_pm_i.order_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT csp_pm_p.id,
		       category_info.name1 AS name1,
		       category_info.name2 AS name2
		FROM csp_pm_p
		LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT csp_pm_c.name,
			       csp_pm_c.short_name AS name1,
			       csp_pm_c.short_name AS name2
			FROM csp_pm_c
			WHERE csp_pm_c.demand <= 2::SMALLINT
		) AS category_info
		ON csp_pm_p.category = category_info.name
		WHERE csp_pm_p.alert_at >= ('18:30:00.178')::TIMETZ
	) AS product_info
	ON csp_pm_i.product_id = product_info.id
	GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
) AS orders_by_customer
ON csp_pm_a.customer_id = orders_by_customer.customer_id
LEFT JOIN csp_pm_tx
ON csp_pm_a.id = csp_pm_tx.a_id
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
	       MAX(repeated_order.v) AS v
	FROM csp_pm_o
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
		       MIN(DISTINCT csp_pm_o.customer_id) AS v
		FROM csp_pm_o
		GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
	) AS repeated_order
	ON csp_pm_o.customer_id = repeated_order.customer_id
	WHERE csp_pm_o.flag != FALSE
	GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
) AS unreferenced_branch
ON csp_pm_a.customer_id = unreferenced_branch.customer_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO test_21890_macro(q) AS TABLE
WITH sel AS (
	SELECT unnest(string_split(q, ',')) AS tag,
	       row_number() OVER () AS node_id
)
SELECT s.tag, s.node_id
FROM sel s
WHERE s.tag = 'a'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
	  SELECT 4096
	  FROM sel args
	  WHERE args.tag = 'b'
	    AND s.node_id > args.node_id
  );
WITH inputs(q) AS (VALUES ('b'), ('a,a'))
SELECT i.q, m.*
FROM inputs i, test_21890_macro(i.q) m
ORDER BY i.q, m.tag, m.node_id;

       CASE WHEN i % 4 = 0 THEN i::VARCHAR END AS s,
       NULL::BIGINT AS null_v

    WHERE last_v IS DISTINCT FROM i - i % 0.0

       OR first_i IS DISTINCT FROM 0
       OR last_null IS NOT NULL
       OR n IS DISTINCT FROM i + 1
)

    SELECT i,
           last_value(v IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS last_v,
           last_value(s IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS last_s,
           first_value(i) OVER w AS first_i,
           last_value(null_v IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS last_null,

SELECT (-1000000000000 + i * 20000000)::BIGINT AS k1,
       (-3000000000000 + i * 60000000)::BIGINT AS k2
FROM range(100000) t(i);
CREATE TABLE multi_build AS
SELECT (-1000000000000 + i * 20000000000)::BIGINT AS k1,
       (-3000000000000 + i * 60000000000)::BIGINT AS k2
FROM range(100) t(i);

SELECT count(*)
FROM multi_probe p
JOIN multi_build b
  ON p.k1 = b.k1
 AND p.k2 = b.k2;

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO test_21890_macro(q) AS TABLE
WITH sel AS (
	SELECT unnest(string_split(q, ',')) AS tag,
	       row_number() OVER () AS node_id
)
SELECT s.tag, s.node_id
FROM sel s WHERE COALESCE((s.tag = 'a'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
	  SELECT -0.0
	  FROM sel args
	  WHERE args.tag = 'b'
	    AND s.node_id > args.node_id
  )), false);
WITH inputs(q) AS (VALUES ('b'), ('a,a'))
SELECT i.q, m.*
FROM inputs i, test_21890_macro(i.q) m
ORDER BY i.q, m.tag, m.node_id;

	select 
		i as k100,
		'2024--170141183460469231731687303715884105728-01'::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL (i) seconds as b100,

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE wide_ranges AS (
	SELECT 
		id,
		'2026-01-01'::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL (id * 5 * 2048 // 7) SECONDS AS start,
		'2026-01-01'::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL ((id + 1) * 5 * 2048 // 7) SECONDS AS stop,
		CHR(65 + (id % 26)::INTEGER) AS symbol,
		149.5 + id * 5 * 2048 / 700.0 AS price,
	FROM range(8) tbl(id)
);
UPDATE wide_ranges SET start = NULL WHERE id = 6;
UPDATE wide_ranges SET stop = NULL WHERE id = 7;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE narrow_ranges AS (
	SELECT 
		id,
		'2026-01-01'::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL (id + 15 * 2048 // 7) SECONDS AS start,
		start + INTERVAL 1 SECOND AS stop,
		CHR(65 + (id % 26)::INTEGER) AS symbol,
		150.0 + id / 100.0 AS bid,
		(id % 2)::BOOLEAN AS active,
	FROM range(2048*5) tbl(id)
);

CREATE TABLE window_results AS
SELECT
	first_value(v) OVER common_window AS plain_first,
	first_value(v IGNORE NULLS) OVER common_window AS nonnull_first,
	sum(v) OVER common_window AS plain_sum,
	sum(DISTINCT v) OVER common_window AS distinct_sum,
	sum(v) FILTER (WHERE v > 1) OVER common_window AS filtered_sum,
	sum(v ORDER BY q DESC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_sum,
	sum(v ORDER BY q ASC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_asc,
	sum(v ORDER BY q DESC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_desc,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY p
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS partition_p_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY q

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO test_21890_macro(q) AS TABLE
WITH sel AS (
	SELECT unnest(string_split(q, ',')) AS tag,
	       row_number() OVER () AS node_id
)
SELECT s.tag, s.node_id
FROM sel s
WHERE s.tag = 'a'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
	  SELECT 1
	  FROM sel args
	  WHERE args.tag = 'b'
	    AND s.node_id > args.node_id
  );

	WITH RECURSIVE subquery(x) AS (
		(SELECT n, true AS exists)
		UNION ALL

				FROM subquery AS previous(a)

		) AS next(y)
		WHERE x > 0
	)

)

CREATE TABLE pair_outer_nested_o(x INTEGER);
INSERT INTO pair_outer_nested_o VALUES (5), (6);
SELECT o.x, q.a, q.lx, q.b
FROM pair_outer_nested_o o
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
	SELECT l.a, l.x AS lx, r.b
	FROM pair_l l
	LEFT JOIN pair_r r ON EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM pair_left_nested_t t
		WHERE EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM pair_left_multi_s s
			WHERE s.a = l.a
			  AND s.b = r.b
			  AND s.c = t.c
			  AND s.c = o.x
		)
	)
) q ON true
ORDER BY o.x, q.a, q.lx, q.b NULLS LAST;
SELECT o.x, q.a, q.lx, q.b
FROM pair_outer_nested_o o
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
	SELECT l.a, l.x AS lx, r.b
	FROM pair_l l
	LEFT JOIN pair_r r ON EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM pair_left_nested_t t
		WHERE EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			WHERE EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM pair_left_multi_s s
				WHERE s.a = l.a
				  AND s.b = r.b
				  AND s.c = t.c
				  AND s.c = o.x
			)
		)
	)
) q ON true
ORDER BY o.x, q.a, q.lx, q.b NULLS LAST;
SELECT outer_l.x, q.a, q.b
FROM pair_l outer_l
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
	SELECT l.a, r.b
	FROM pair_l l
	FULL OUTER JOIN pair_r r ON EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM pair_s s
		WHERE s.a = l.a
		  AND s.b = r.b
		  AND s.a = outer_l.a
	)
	WHERE l.x = outer_l.x
) q ON true
ORDER BY outer_l.x, q.a, q.b NULLS LAST;
SELECT count(*), min(1) FROM (SELECT outer_l.x, q.a, q.b
FROM pair_l outer_l
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
	SELECT l.a, r.b
	FROM pair_l l
	LEFT JOIN pair_r r ON l.a = outer_l.a AND r.b IN (
		SELECT s.b
		FROM pair_s s
		WHERE s.a = l.a
	)
	WHERE l.x = outer_l.x
) q ON true
ORDER BY outer_l.x, q.a, q.b NULLS LAST) AS _agg_21 LIMIT 10;

CREATE TABLE window_results AS
SELECT
	first_value(v) OVER common_window AS plain_first,
	first_value(v IGNORE NULLS) OVER common_window AS nonnull_first,
	sum(v) OVER common_window AS plain_sum,
	sum(DISTINCT v) OVER common_window AS distinct_sum,
	sum(v) FILTER (WHERE v > 1) OVER common_window AS filtered_sum,
	sum(v ORDER BY q DESC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_sum,
	sum(v ORDER BY q ASC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_asc,
	sum(v ORDER BY q DESC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_desc,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY p
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS partition_p_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY q
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS partition_q_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY p, q
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
	) AS included_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY p, q
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
		EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW
	) AS excluded_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN p PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS dynamic_p_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN q PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS dynamic_q_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY q, p
		ORDER BY v
		RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
	) AS reordered_partition_sum,
	lead(v, 1, -1) OVER common_window AS next_value,
	lag(v, 1, -1) OVER common_window AS previous_value
FROM window_input
WINDOW common_window AS (
	PARTITION BY p, q
	ORDER BY v
	ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
);
